title: Shopping cart — cast-iron & kitchenware store
notes: v2 is a Next.js rebuild with CSS-modules hashes. The cart <table> becomes a <ul> of CartLine cards, ordered most-recently-added first; quantity steppers become a QuantitySelector with text inputs, new React ids and reworded aria-labels; 'Remove' links become icon+text buttons. A 'Saved for later' list (more 'Remove' buttons), a protection-plan upsell and a mobile checkout bar repeating the estimated total are added. The order summary moves into <hs-order-summary>'s shadow root, where a gift-card form with its own 'Apply' button now precedes the promo-code form and the subtotal shows the same amount as the total.
